roleTitle: Search Quality Analyst, Knowledge Search Product
jobDescription: The knowledge search product indexes an enterprise's documents and answers its employees' searches. The Search Quality Analyst measures search quality with the relevance judgement programme, analyses query logs for failure patterns, prepares the weekly quality report for the search product manager, proposes ranking rule changes with their expected effect, and documents each proposal's limitations. Ranking changes are approved by the search product manager. Reports to the search product manager; works with the ranking engineers, the relevance judges and the customer success team.
requirements: Measures search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard.
Analyses query logs for failure patterns and prepares the weekly quality report.
Proposes ranking rule changes with their expected effect, with approval staying with the search product manager.
Coordinates judgement batches with the relevance judges and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each proposal's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Search quality analyst on a knowledge search product for three years, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard with monthly judgement batches.
Analysed the query logs for failure patterns each week and prepared the weekly quality report for the search product manager, with the reports filed in the search quality folder.
Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with their expected effect on the quality metrics; each was approved or declined by the search product manager, recorded on the proposal.
Coordinated the judgement batches with the six relevance judges through the batch schedule, recording which batch designs were mine and which followed the standard templates.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each ranking rule proposal for the ranking engineers.
Work sample: one weekly quality report, two ranking rule proposals with their decision records and one judgement batch design, with the search quality folder references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former search product manager: confirmed the candidate ran the judgement programme and prepared the proposals in the period, with the ranking decisions taken by the manager, and confirmed the dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate confirmed availability for the take-home exercise this week and has no constraints on the office days.
